verdicts.reason: A is the original layout dropped into the taller canvas without rearranging it: every element stays at its original small size in a band across the middle, with large dead areas above and below, so it reads as a letterboxed copy. B actually rearranges the design and gives it a strong headline and a large shoe and CTA, but it has flaws: the copy wraps awkwardly ('closes / Thursday.'), the oversized LIMITED pill sits beside the CTA and competes with it instead of staying subordinate, and the headline (left edge ~28px) and copy column (~357px) don't share an alignment axis.
